SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers LETTERS OF THE ALPHABET & FRENCH ACCENT MARKS, part of FRENCH BRAILLE in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade four General.

Key inquiry question: How do you distinguish letters that are reverse to each other? 2. How do you distinguish the French letters of the alphabet from the English ones?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

• Learners could be guided to state the letters of

sequence orally.

each of these characters.

• Learners could be guided to read the letters of

the alphabet and the French accent marks on a

card.

• Learners could be guided to write the letters of

the alphabet and the French accent marks.

• In pairs learners could practice reading letters

of the alphabet by identifying the letters that

are reverse of each other such as DF, EI, JH,

RW.

• In turns learners could practice reading and

writing the French accent marks in braille.

• In groups learners could associate the dots with

letters of the alphabet by singing or

formulating a letter-dot song.
